cars.name: Bugatti Chiron (2016-2022)
cars.brief: Bugatti Chiron. Signature: the horseshoe grille (black mesh, relief hex/grid) with the EB oval badge on top (draw a simplified oval EB badge behind SHOW_BADGE), the quad LED headlights (four small square lamp units per side in a slim black strip, white), the C-line and the central spine running up the hood, huge lower side intakes with vertical fins, the wide low nose. Very wide and low.

cars.name: Lamborghini Urus (2018+)
cars.brief: Lamborghini Urus super-SUV. Signature: the Y-shaped LED DRL in slim angular headlights (white strokes), the tall hexagonal / Y-motif lower intakes, the large central grille with hexagon mesh (relief hex), the hood with the strong centre ridge and two creases, the Lamborghini shield on the nose (badge type 'shield'). Taller SUV proportions - a taller keychain is correct. Verify the generation/facelift on the photo.

cars.name: Toyota GR86 (2022+, ZN8)
cars.brief: Second-gen Toyota GR86 (2022+). Signature: the large trapezoid lower grille with mesh (relief hex/grid) and the functional corner 'fangs' / side vents, slim headlights with the L-shaped LED DRL (white strokes), the GR86-specific front bumper (no Toyota logo on the grille; small Toyota badge on the nose - simplified three-oval behind SHOW_BADGE), low hood with two creases. Must be clearly different from the BRZ in the same batch (different bumper, lamp graphics).

cars.name: Subaru BRZ (2022+, ZD8)
cars.brief: Second-gen Subaru BRZ (2022+). Signature: the hexagonal upper grille with the Subaru star-cluster oval badge (simplified oval with small stars behind SHOW_BADGE), headlights with the C-shaped / hawk-eye LED DRL (white strokes), the lower bumper with the wide intake and corner vents, low hood. Must be clearly different from the GR86 in the same batch.

cars.name: BMW M5 (G90, 2025+)
cars.brief: New BMW M5 G90 (2025+). Signature: the large illuminated-outline kidney grille (big, wide, with horizontal/vertical bars - check the photo), slim headlights with the vertical LED DRL elements (white strokes), the massive M bumper with huge outer intakes and a wide centre intake, hood creases, roundel (badge type 'roundel'). BMW rule from the user: exactly ONE front tow-hook cover (a single ring, mirror=False) on the side the photo shows it (viewer's left on BMWs), only if visible - never a mirrored pair.

cars.name: BMW M5 Competition (F90 LCI)
cars.brief: BMW M5 F90 (prefer the 2021+ LCI Competition). Signature: the wide twin kidneys with black double vertical slats (relief vbars), LCI laser headlights with the L-shaped DRL (white strokes; pre-LCI has hexagonal rings - use what the photo shows), the three large lower intakes of the M bumper, the bulging hood with creases, roundel (badge type 'roundel'). Must be clearly different from the G90 M5 in the same batch. BMW rule from the user: exactly ONE front tow-hook cover (a single ring, mirror=False) on the side the photo shows it (viewer's left on BMWs), only if visible - never a mirrored pair.

cars.name: Ferrari SF90 Stradale (2019+)
cars.brief: Ferrari SF90 Stradale. Signature: the slim C-shaped LED headlight signature at the upper outer corners (white strokes), the full-width black lower 'mouth' with the central splitter blade and side intakes, the smooth sculpted hood with the central channel, the Ferrari shield on the nose (badge type 'shield'). Very low and wide.

cars.name: Tesla Model 3 (Highland, 2024+)
cars.brief: Refreshed Tesla Model 3 'Highland' (2024+). Signature: no grille - a smooth nose; very slim angular headlights with the thin LED DRL line (white strokes), the slim lower intake slot and small side intakes, the T badge on the nose (simplified T behind SHOW_BADGE), the smooth rounded hood. Clean and minimal - a mostly white face is correct for this car.

cars.name: Tesla Model S Plaid (2021+)
cars.brief: Tesla Model S Plaid (2021+ refresh). Signature: smooth grille-less nose with the T badge (simplified T behind SHOW_BADGE), wide headlights with the LED DRL arc (white strokes), the wide lower intake band with mesh (relief hex/grid) and small side openings, the gently sloped hood with two soft creases. Must be clearly different from the Model 3 in the same batch (wider, flatter lamps, bigger lower intake).

cars.name: Koenigsegg Jesko (2019+)
cars.brief: Koenigsegg Jesko. Signature: the wide low nose with the large central intake and front splitter, the slim headlights with the LED DRL line (white strokes), the prominent front canards/dive planes, the hood with the central vents, the Koenigsegg shield badge (badge type 'shield'). Very low and wide.

cars.name: Ferrari F40 (1987-1992)
cars.brief: Ferrari F40 classic. Signature: pop-up headlights DOWN (closed) with the rectangular fixed lamp units behind clear covers at the front corners (black rectangles with white lamp discs/strokes), the thin horizontal nose with the three NACA-duct hood vents (black), the wide low black radiator mouth with the central divider, the prancing-horse shield badge (badge type 'shield'). Very flat 80s wedge.

cars.name: Lamborghini Huracan EVO (2019-2024)
cars.brief: Lamborghini Huracan EVO. Signature: the Y-shaped LED DRL in the slim angular headlights (white strokes), the large side air intakes with the Y-shaped/hexagonal dividers, the central lower intake, the hood with the centre ridge and creases, the Lamborghini shield on the nose (badge type 'shield'). Must be clearly different from the Aventador SVJ already in the line (smaller, simpler intakes, different lamp shape).

cars.name: Chevrolet Corvette C6 (2005-2013)
cars.brief: C6 Corvette coupe (Z06/Grand Sport front acceptable). Signature: the exposed (non pop-up) teardrop headlights with the round lamp elements (white rings/discs on black), the wide low oval mouth grille with mesh (relief grid/hex), the crossed-flags emblem on the nose (badge type 'flags'), the sharp hood with the central crease, the small fog/turn lamps in the bumper. Different from the C7 and C8 in the line.

cars.name: Chevrolet Corvette C5 (1997-2004)
cars.brief: C5 Corvette with the pop-up headlights CLOSED (smooth nose). Signature: the rounded nose with the round crossed-flags emblem (badge type 'flags'), the wide low mouth intake with the horizontal divider, the round fog lamps and the long oval parking/turn lamps in the bumper (white on black), the smooth hood with the soft centre bulge. Rounded 90s shape - clearly different from the C6/C7/C8 in the line.
